sources: recreation.gov campsite search API for asset 232274 (21 sites)
https://www.fs.usda.gov/sites/nfs/files/publication/2026%20Campground%20Table%20WhiteRiverNF_All%20Campgrounds_0.pdf (2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates)

values.note: $25 a night (recreation.gov 2026-2027 and the FS page; the forest's 2026 table says $27). One RV with tow vehicle per site; an extra vehicle pays a nightly fee collected at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232274/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-24..10-01 and 2027-05-27..10-01: PeakSTANDARD NONELECTRIC 25) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/camp-hale-memorial-campground ('Single Site: $25 per night') + recreation.gov notice 'Extra vehicle will be charged a per night fee and collected at the campground', read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/camp-hale-memorial-campground ('No hook-ups') + recreation.gov ('Drinking water and electrical hook- ups are not available at this site'); catalog: all 21 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, read 2026-10-26

values.note: Gravel road, parking area and spurs; all sites back-in, catalog lengths 30-40 ft (the FS page says spurs up to 60 ft). Little or no shade since hazard trees were removed.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232274 (21 sites, all Back-In, Max Vehicle Length 30-40: site 008 40) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/camp-hale-memorial-campground ('There are 21 campsites available'; 'Parking spurs up to 60'') + recreation.gov ('The road, parking area and spurs in the campground are gravel'; 'there is little or no shade in the campground'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Bear-proof food lockers at each site; bring your own water.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/camp-hale-memorial-campground ('Vault Toilets'; 'Potable water is not available at this site') + recreation.gov ('Visitors must provide their own water'; 'Bear-proof food lockers are provided at each site'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Estimated opening dates; they can shift with the weather.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/sites/nfs/files/publication/2026%20Campground%20Table%20WhiteRiverNF_All%20Campgrounds_0.pdf ('Camp Hale CG 9,300 21/60' 5/24-10/2'; 'These are estimated opening dates'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Book at least 3 days ahead. The site must be occupied the first night; a reserved site is held until 11am the day after arrival, then released. Catalog site 005 is not reservable.

booking.source: recreation.gov 232274 rules (reservationCutOff 3; weekend minimums 0 soft = no rule) + notices ('Campers must occupy the site the first night'; 'Reserved Sites will be held until check out time (ELEVEN) the day following your arrival date') + rates Peak Season 2026-05-24..10-01; FS 2026 table 'R', read 2026-10-26

note: Eagle-Holy Cross Ranger District, White River NF, inside the Camp Hale-Continental Divide National Monument: in the wide, open Camp Hale valley off US 24 about 15 mi south of Minturn, near the headwaters of the Eagle River, where the 10th Mountain Division trained in WWII; run by concessionaire American Land & Leisure. OHVs may drive in and out of the campground only. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + catalog + FS page + 2026 forest table: confirmed $25, no electric (added no water/sewer), 21 sites, max 40 ft (catalog); added back-in only, vault toilets/no potable water, season 5/24-10/2, 3-day cutoff, booking season 5/24-10/1. Name current (FS + rec.gov 'Camp Hale Memorial Campground'), now inside the Camp Hale-Continental Divide National Monument; no alert or closure order for it; season ended 10/2. Pin 25 m from the site centroid. Note: dropped '21 sites, sites to ~40 ft' and 'Reservable online', and 'along the Eagle River' (FS: near its headwaters).
flags: Fee conflict: recreation.gov's 2026/2027 rate and the FS campground page say $25; the forest's 2026 campground table says $27. Recorded $25.
Length conflict: the FS page and 2026 table give parking spurs up to 60 ft; recreation.gov's per-site catalog gives 30-40 ft (one site at 40). Kept 40. Either way a 23-ft motorhome fits every site.
Phone empty: Eagle-Holy Cross Ranger District 970-827-5715 (forest offices page; the campground page lists no phone). recreation.gov lists concessionaire American Land & Leisure 801-226-3564.
